PSM-level MaxQuant output for a phospho-enriched TMT18plex fraction

Source: R/psm_tmt_phospho_mq.R
psm_tmt_phospho_mq.Rd

MaxQuant evidence.txt PSM-level output for the phospho-enriched fraction of a real TMT18plex experiment, subsetted to a random selection of proteins carrying more than one phosphopeptide PSM, plus a sample of contaminant, decoy and non-unique-master-protein PSMs for use as the MaxQuant worked example in the PTM site quantification vignette.

Includes the Phospho..STY..Probabilities and Phospho..STY. columns needed by parse_ptm_candidates_mq, which is the reason this dataset exists: MaxQuant writes localisation probabilities inline in the peptide sequence, where Proteome Discoverer writes them as a separate list of percentages, so psm_tmt_phospho cannot demonstrate both.

psm_tmt_factorial is the total (non-enriched) fraction of the same labelled pool, acquired from the same plex, so the two share tmt_factorial_design and sample columns are named to match its rownames. The design is a 3 x 2 of cell line against treatment, three replicates each.

inst/extdata/tmt_phospho_mq_proteome.fasta.gz holds the sequences of the retained master proteins, taken from the search database, so that add_peptide_positions_from_cleavage can place peptides without querying UniProt.

Usage

psm_tmt_phospho_mq

Format

An object of class data.frame with 10170 rows and 68 columns.
